what.text: This page follows refugees from Cambodia in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 11332 refugees from Cambodia.
France hosts the largest share, 92.2%, followed by Thailand, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Cambodia from 1967 to 1975, with the KR, and from 1978 to 1998, with the KNUFNS, KPNLF, KR and FUNCINPEC, at war level in some years.
It also records interstate armed conflicts between Cambodia and Vietnam from 1975 to 1977, and between Cambodia and Thailand in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1971 at 57000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 192843, at the end of 1980, and the main years of displacement in the data include 1978 and 1980 to 1982.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
